title_en: The last page of my exercise book
incoming_zh:
捡到信的人：

我想做会动的画。数学练习本最后一页，画着一艘能飞的船。爸爸看见，说先把分数顾好。
我知道他怕我吃苦，可每次听见“不切实际”，就想把那页撕掉。今天没撕。我把船剪下来，贴在这里了。
你小时候有没有一件很想做、又不敢说的事？

小岸
incoming_en:
Hello,

I want to make drawings move. There is a flying boat on the last page of my maths book. Dad saw it and told me to mind my grades.
I know he worries. But every “be realistic” makes me want to tear the page out. Today I cut out the boat instead. Here it is.
Did you ever want something you were afraid to say?

An
reply_zh:
小岸：
船先留着。
这一页，给你的想象停靠。

周末能不能给它画下一格？
我想看看它会飞去哪儿。

Solmere 的朋友
reply_en:
Dear An,
Keep the boat.
There is room here for your imagination.

Could you draw its next frame this weekend?
I would like to see where it goes.

A friend in Solmere

exchanges.incoming_zh:
你好：

我在印刷店排了十四年版。新系统半分钟做出一张，我还在找字距。老板没说要换人，我倒先睡不着了。
女儿昨天让我给她的姓名贴挑字体，说机器挑的不好看。我高兴了一会儿，又去算下个月的房贷。
这张旧工单上的红铅笔是我的。我想学新东西，又怕连从哪儿开始都问得很笨。

程远
exchanges.incoming_en:
Hello,

Fourteen years setting type. The new system makes a page while I am still checking the spacing. Nobody has said I must leave. I lie awake anyway.
Yesterday my daughter asked me to choose a font for her name labels. “The machine picks ugly ones.” I smiled, then went back to next month’s mortgage.
These red pencil marks on the old job sheet are mine. I want to learn, but even my first question feels foolish.

Cheng
exchanges.reply_zh:
程远：
这张红铅笔工单，值得留着。

给女儿挑字的眼光，也跟你一起往前走。
先留一个下午，只学一件新事。

Solmere 的朋友
exchanges.reply_en:
Dear Cheng,
Keep the job sheet with its red pencil marks.

The eye your daughter trusts comes with you.
Perhaps one afternoon, and one new thing to learn.

A friend in Solmere

exchanges.incoming_zh:
海那边的朋友：

儿子给我订了很软的饭菜，都挺好，就是没问我爱不爱吃。我说周四想去听戏，他说路远，在家看也一样。
其实我不是不会用电视。我是想穿那件蓝外套，跟卖票的人说两句话。
他们忙，我知道。我也还有自己的周四。旧戏票贴给你看，背面还有我当年记的公交车次。

老何
exchanges.incoming_en:
To a friend across the sea,

My son orders soft meals for me. Very thoughtful, though nobody asks what I like. I said I wanted to see a play on Thursday. He said the journey was long; I could watch at home.
I know how to use the television. I want to wear my blue coat and talk to the person selling tickets.
They are busy. I still have Thursdays of my own. Here is an old ticket, with the bus number on the back.

He
exchanges.reply_zh:
何阿姨：
周四，穿蓝外套吧。

票根背面还有空位，
留给这一次出门的小事。
等你告诉我，那出戏好不好看。

Solmere 的朋友
exchanges.reply_en:
Dear Mrs He,
The blue coat, on Thursday.

There is space on the back of the ticket
for the small things from this outing.
Tell me whether you liked the play.

A friend in Solmere
